title: Security Remediation & Authorization Enforcement Readiness
rationale: Source signals are not equivalent to runtime authorization evidence. Critical tenant-scoped persistence remains unverified.

findings.evidence: Registry controller appears to derive tenant from authenticated request user and rejects missing tenant claim.
findings.action: Verify JWT validation, claim issuer/trust, membership status, and tenant scoping in service/database queries.

findings.evidence: Checks for a visible @Roles decorator on the registry persistence controller.
findings.action: Confirm global guard policy and add explicit role policy only after verifying existing role metadata/guard conventions.

findings.evidence: Looks for visible guard wiring in the registry module and root module only.
findings.action: Trace actual NestJS global guard registration and prove unauthorized requests are rejected in a live test environment.

findings.evidence: Looks for a global ValidationPipe signal in API bootstrap/root module.
findings.action: Verify whitelist, forbidNonWhitelisted, transform, and DTO validators at runtime; do not assume presence means strict configuration.

findings.evidence: Static route inspection cannot prove every query includes authenticated tenant scope.
findings.action: Add live cross-tenant read/write tests for every critical domain and inspect all service queries before production.

findings.evidence: No runtime authorization test evidence is generated by this source-only checklist.
findings.action: Run Phase 170 with dedicated non-production tenants, then retain CI results and security review sign-off.

limitations: Does not modify application code or database.
Does not execute HTTP requests, NestJS guards, JWT validation, or database queries.
Human review and live tests are required before closing findings.
